_grading.operationalization: FIRED := the product-output Skill tool is invoked in the fresh-session stream-json transcript. SILENT := no such invocation. Behavioral signature recorded as corroboration.
_grading.fire_signature: Deliverable follows the contract: format decision stated (user-named format wins), owning skills routed and named, real file produced with descriptive dated name, validate-fix-repeat loop visible, delivery manifest present with a not-checked line.
_grading.silent_signature: Direct answer or ordinary work without delivery ceremony for non-deliverable turns (chat answers, code edits, intermediate drafts).
_grading.surface: Claude Code headless (claude -p), project or personal scope
_grading.gate: 2 runs per prompt: >=83% of should-fire runs fire (>=9/10); >=5/6 should-not runs stay silent
_grading.status: AUTHORED 2026-08-10 — NOT YET RUN. Prompts are self-contained (no absent-file references) per INC-2/INC-8.
_grading._note: Draft accompanying results/2026-08-10/product-output-skill/REPORT.md. Moves to evals/product-output.json only on owner adoption of the proposal.
